headline: Operating profit rises on a thin margin, net profit halves
summary_short: Operating profit was KRW 79.4B (+31.9% y/y, margin 7.5%) and EPS was KRW 209, down 47.5% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of KRW 209 fell 43.2% q/q and 47.5% y/y. A Herald report puts operating profit at KRW 79.4B, up 63.9% q/q, with a 7.5% margin that is the lowest third-quarter reading in three years. Pre-tax profit was KRW 21.8B, down 51.9% y/y. Nine-month sales were KRW 3.32T, up 49.1%. Guidance is not assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Operating profit comes from a single Herald article that could not be cross-checked. EPS is Yahoo data.
